text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to rescind the existing alternate-side Thursday parking prohibition on the east side of Hendrick Avenue, between St. Clair Avenue West and the south end of Hendrick Avenue, in order to generate additional on-street parking opportunities.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect on each Thursday, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the east side of Hendrick Avenue, between the first lane south of St. Clair Avenue West and the south end of Hendrick Avenue. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times except each Thursday, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the west side of Hendrick Avenue, between the first lane south of St. Clair Avenue West and the south end of Hendrick Avenue. 3. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Hendrick Avenue, between the first lane south of St. Clair Avenue West and the south end of Hendrick Avenue.
